dedupe_keys.name: cyclic quasi static tests on infilled reinforced concrete frames with different typologies of masonry constituting the infills

description: Single-storey, single-bay concrete frames at two-thirds scale are tested under lateral quasi-static cycles. The infills use calcarenite masonry, hollow clay units or lightweight concrete. The release provides comparative evidence for representing how masonry type affects infilled-frame response under the reported test arrangement. The dataset is provided by University of Palermo through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2014. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0.
